summary: Comprehensive backend test suite for Tennant TMS — 37/37 tests passed (100%). Covered all endpoints: health, auth (Bearer header), admin/seed (force), facilities, shipments (list/filter/get/create), KPIs, weather (real Open-Meteo verified), news/traffic/integrations (mocked), trailers, HS lookup, links, chat channels/messages, WebSocket /api/ws/chat (auth + send + receive broadcast verified), freight-bills (list, summary, approve/pay/dispute), carrier onboarding (create, toggle docs, approve/reject, invalid decision rejection), driver mobile auth-free (checkin updates shipment status & location, GET shipment, list checkins requires auth), and logout.

minor.issue: Endpoint only deletes session if session_token cookie is present; Bearer-only requests do not invalidate server-side session. Idempotent but token remains valid until expiry.
Open (no auth required) — could be abused in production; consider gating behind admin role or env flag.
Auth-free by design but has no rate limiting / shared-secret. Acceptable for MVP; flag for production hardening.
No 404 when bill_id does not exist — silently returns {ok:true} (update_one matched_count not checked).

action_items: (Optional) Gate /api/admin/seed behind auth or env flag for production safety.
(Optional) In /api/freight-bills/{id}/approve|dispute|pay, return 404 when no document matches.
(Optional) Logout should also invalidate Bearer-token sessions (delete by token from header).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1041 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth.py, shipments.py, freight.py, drivers.py) for maintainability (>700 LOC threshold).
All MongoDB queries correctly use {"_id": 0} projection — good.
Pydantic models used for input validation on create endpoints — good.
CORS allows credentials with allow_origins='*' default — should restrict via CORS_ORIGINS env in production.
Random data in /api/kpis trend is generated on every call (non-deterministic). For demo OK; for prod analytics use real aggregation.
freight-bills approve/dispute endpoints don't validate bill exists before update.
test_credentials: Created via mongosh per /app/auth_testing.md — session token injected directly into test_database.user_sessions (Emergent auth mocked). No real credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: Invoked POST /api/admin/seed?force=true which (re)seeds 48 shipments, ~12 documents, 6 chat msgs, 30 freight bills, 3 carrier onboardings. One TEST_ prefixed carrier onboarding created by test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully working. All 37 pytest cases pass against public URL. Auth uses Bearer token from /app/auth_testing.md mongosh script. WebSocket /api/ws/chat auths via ?token=... query param and broadcasts JSON messages. Driver endpoints /api/driver/checkin and /api/driver/shipment/{id} are intentionally auth-free; /api/driver/checkins requires auth. Freight bill state transitions don't 404 on missing IDs — minor issue logged.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking functionality found.
